-                           D E S C R I P T I O N                              -

This txt file contains flight IDs where at least one frame contains no detected
airborne object. Used to evaluate the false alarm rate of the model on sequences
with periods of no visible target, isolating whether the main failure mode is
missed detections or spurious detections on empty frames.
